name: Ghaldur's Lair
description: Three round galleries at the top of the citadel, and a throne. Ghaldur is not in any of them that you can see.

g_a.name: The Ashen Gallery
g_a.description: A round gallery of white stone, bare except for a ring of cold braziers. The stair you came up is behind you. Nothing is in the room that you can see, and yet the air has weight.

g_b.name: The Hollow Gallery
g_b.description: A second gallery as round and bare as the first, but lower. A thin cold draught runs across it and out of sight.

g_c.name: The Throne of Ash
g_c.description: A third gallery with a throne of black iron at the far end of it. Nobody sits in the throne. The iron of the arms is warm.

p_cell.name: The Princess's Cell
p_cell.description: A narrow room at the top of the throne's stair, with one barred window and one unbarred door. A young woman stands in the middle of it.
